analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. (Win Championship / Elite Contender) proposes trading Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR, C-AVI 98.6 / D-AVI 99.4) to Mile High Royal Lions (Playoff Push) in exchange for Garrett Wilson (WR, C-AVI 87.5 / D-AVI 91.8), Marvin Harrison (WR, C-AVI 69.6 / D-AVI 85.4), and a 2028 1st-round pick. While the concept of trading JSN to diversify into two high-end wide receivers makes strategic sense for a 16-team contender, demanding Mile High's 2028 1st on top creates a significant overpay that Mile High is unlikely to accept (51% acceptance probability). AVI recommends revising the offer by removing the 2028 1st pick to create a balanced, highly realistic 2-for-1 transaction.

submitted.summary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. receives substantial value by converting Jaxon Smith-Njigba into Garrett Wilson, Marvin Harrison, and a 2028 1st. While losing JSN causes an 11.1 C-AVI drop at WR1, Wilson steps in as a high-end WR1, Harrison adds premier WR depth in a 16-team league, and the 2028 1st adds championship liquidity. However, the package heavily overcharges Mile High Royal Lions.

recommended.summary: By removing the 2028 1st round pick, Corgi Loaf receives Garrett Wilson and Marvin Harrison straight up for JSN. Corgi Loaf gains high-floor WR depth and a top-tier starter without pricing Mile High out of negotiations.

publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Public dynasty consensus ranks Jaxon Smith-Njigba as a top-3 overall dynasty WR following a strong opening stretch. Garrett Wilson is viewed as a high-end WR2 with upside now that he is healthy and commanding a 29% target share in NY. Marvin Harrison's public perception has experienced a slight dip following a quiet Week 1 (1 catch, 33 yards) amidst target competition in Arizona, making him a perceived buy-low dynasty asset.
publicMarketAnalysis.aviVsMarket: AVI's valuation of JSN (98.6 C-AVI / 99.4 D-AVI) matches public consensus. AVI values Garrett Wilson (87.5 C-AVI) higher than Marvin Harrison (69.6 C-AVI) due to immediate target share stability.
relevantContext: JSN is currently the highest-valued dynasty wide receiver in 1QB PPR setups.
Garrett Wilson recovered from his 2025 knee injury and saw a 29% target share in Week 1 of 2026.
Marvin Harrison faced target competition from Michael Wilson and Trey McBride in Week 1, lowering his immediate redraft floor.
In 16-team deep leagues, two top-25 WRs hold substantial package value against single S-tier assets.

analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. enters the 2026 campaign as an Elite Contender targeting immediate championship upside. With a core featuring Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Malik Nabers, and Tyler Warren, the roster has surplus wide receiver talent and draft assets that can be leveraged to acquire high-ceiling starting running backs and tier-one wide receivers. By capitalizing on publicly shopped trade-block assets like Amon-Ra St. Brown and De'Von Achane, Corgi Loaf can upgrade starting-lineup efficiency without sacrificing short-term competitive viability.
